newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Minproc chief executive Anderton resigns.
newsitem.headline: Minproc chief executive Anderton resigns.

text.p: Contract mining group Minproc Engineers Ltd said on Thursday its chief executive, Peter Anderton had announced his intention to resign.

"The company has been restructured, a new management team is now in place, there are good long term contracts on the books and all divisions of the company have improved their operating performance. It is an appropriate point to pass over leadership," Anderton said in a statement.
Minproc said it would appoint a new chief executive in the next two weeks.
